approved_remediation.image_and_gate: Build a fresh no-cache image with the candidate commit/tree and replacement manifest labels, inspect its immutable image identity, and invoke the final-image provider gate exactly once in the new namespace before running the remaining T048 verification.
approved_remediation.preserved_evidence: T041-T046 remain accepted and unchanged. Prior T047-T048 attempts remain historical evidence and are not relabelled or overwritten.

implementation_intent: Dispatch a fresh e2e-runner under the accepted T047-T048 boundary. The runner may create only untracked TestResults evidence and a disposable detached worktree, must not edit tracked product, test, plan, contract, task, story, or workflow files, and must stop without a second provider invocation if the namespace is consumed or any identity check fails.
